analysis.executiveSummary: Corgi Loaf Baking Co. executes a high-impact championship move by trading Saquon Barkley and a 2027 2nd round pick for D'Andre Swift. Moving from Barkley (62.9 C-AVI) to Swift (81.3 C-AVI) yields an immediate +18.4 C-AVI upgrade in Corgi Loaf's starting RB1 slot, providing healthy, high-floor production for a title push. For All Hail King Jesus, who is executing a Retool, receiving Saquon Barkley alongside a 2027 2nd round draft pick adds valuable pick capital while maintaining starter-level talent. Market Reality scores this transaction at an 86% acceptance probability as a highly realistic win-win trade for both franchises.

submitted.summary: Corgi Loaf Baking Co. achieves a net +18.4 C-AVI starting lineup boost at RB1 by acquiring D'Andre Swift (81.3 C-AVI) for Saquon Barkley (62.9 C-AVI) and a 2027 2nd pick. Swift provides immediate durability and passing-game volume for a championship push. All Hail King Jesus successfully advances its Retool goal by acquiring 2027 2nd draft capital plus Barkley's elite talent.

publicMarketAnalysis.summary: Public dynasty markets view Barkley and Swift in similar value tiers, but Swift currently enjoys greater stability due to recent extension security and good health, whereas Barkley faces short-term injury and team volatility in Philadelphia.
publicMarketAnalysis.aviVsMarket: AVI rates Swift higher in current C-AVI (81.3 vs 62.9) due to Barkley's lingering hamstring and back issues, while D-AVI remains closely aligned (86.7 vs 85.0).
relevantContext: Barkley returned in Week 8 but played through lingering hamstring/back issues on a 2-5 Eagles squad.
Swift signed a 3-year extension in Chicago and maintains high PPR floor in Ben Johnson's offense.
